items.source: This will typically be called with the expectation that the attribute is already present, with an exception to be thrown if this method returns null.
items.translation: 这通常会在预期该属性已存在的情况下被调用，如果此方法返回 `null` 则抛出异常。

items.source:
Can be called for new attributes as well as for existing attributes.
In the latter case, this signals that the attribute value may have been modified.
items.translation: 也可用于新属性以及现有属性。在后一种情况下，这表示该属性的值可能已被修改。

items.source: Indicates that the attribute name will not be used anymore.
items.translation: 表示该属性名称将不再使用。

items.source: Strategy interface for storing model attributes in a backend session.
items.translation: 用于在后台会话中存储模型属性的策略接口。

items.source: Clean up the specified attribute in the backend session.
items.translation: 清理后端会话中指定的属性。

items.source: Retrieve the specified attribute from the backend session.
items.translation: 从后端会话中检索指定的属性。

items.source: Store the supplied attribute in the backend session.
items.translation: 将提供的属性存储在后端会话中。

items.source: the current attribute value, or null if none
items.translation: 当前属性值，或者如果没有则为null。
